name: Hurricane + Earthquake Tracker
author: Olivier Melcher
description: A calm, native Omarchy tracker for NHC cyclones, location-based tropical alerts, and recent USGS earthquakes.

barWidget.description: NHC cyclone activity, watched-location alerts, and recent USGS earthquakes

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the tracker checks the National Hurricane Center for updates.

schema.label: Earthquake refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the tracker checks the USGS magnitude 4.5+ weekly feed for updates.

schema.label: Online place lookup
schema.description: Allow typed place searches through Open-Meteo, nearby-place naming through OpenStreetMap, and a one-time coarse location lookup when Omarchy has no saved weather coordinates. Turn this off to keep location setup local.

schema.label: Basin alerts
schema.description: Notify when an NHC outlook reaches your threshold anywhere in this source basin. Add location-specific proximity alerts from the app's Alerts view. Existing systems form a quiet baseline.

schema.label: Formation threshold
schema.description: Minimum seven-day tropical cyclone formation chance for basin and nearby-place notifications.

schema.label: Named storm alerts
schema.description: Also notify when NHC begins advisories for a new tropical cyclone in the selected region.
